messages.subject: SpatialEpiApp - Report Tab PDF Download - Warning: Error in : pandoc version 1.12.3 or higher is required and was not found
parts:
Hi everyone.

 

I was unable to download the PDF report from SpatialEpiApp and I got the following warning message:

 

Warning: Error in : pandoc version 1.12.3 or higher is required and was not found (see the help page ?rmarkdown::pandoc_available).

[No stack trace available]

Could you please help me with that?

Thank you.

Y

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] SpatialEpiApp - Report Tab PDF Download - Warning: Error in : pandoc version 1.12.3 or higher is required and was not found
parts:
The error seems quite clear to me. You'll need to install or upgrade
pandoc. If you are using RStudio, then upgrade RStudio as it includes
pandoc. If not install a recent version of pandoc from
https://pandoc.org/

Best regards,
